0022600122.text: The Mavericks (1-1, 3rd in the Southwest and 9th in the West) are on the road against the Miami Heat (0-3, on a three-game losing streak, 5th in the Southeast and 15th in the East). Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 1-1, with Dallas winning the most recent meeting 118-108 in Dallas on December 3, 2025.
